statement: For the actual negative basis X1,...,X7 and positive basis Yi=B_+(Xi) under the explicit F23 based isomorphism, every continuous finite-field affine representation has equal images of mathcal K_sign and R_sign on the exact locus chi(Y5)=chi(Y6)=1 and product_i chi(Yi)=1. Equivalently the negative character is (r,s,t,u,1,1,(rstu)^-1). This includes every characteristic, scalar-field extension degree and larger original coefficient field. On the part C=<u,(rstu)^-1> nontrivial, put k1=F_p(u,rstu), k0=F_p(r,s,t,u), m=[k0:k1]. The summed continuous H1 restriction of the m k1-Frobenius conjugates is injective. Its cocycle kernel consists exactly of principal tuples whose parameters sum to zero, with rank 6m+1 on 7m coordinates.
